thesis: The episode explores the people and processes behind capital allocation by interviewing Chris Duvose, a managing director at Venture Investment Associates who manages relationships with venture fund managers. The conversation covers his career path from strategy consulting and investment banking to venture capital, while also addressing the perception versus reality of investing in this subsector.
